title.en: Brush Talks from Dream Brook: A Builder, a Fallen Star, Lightning and Stone Bamboo

edition.en: Five entries from books 18, 20 and 21, as given on Chinese Wikisource, with the book headings added for orientation; none of them appears in the library’s other selections from the Brush Talks (S-002041, S-002042, S-006005). In the entry on the Timberwork Classic a variant note (一作「造」), a pronunciation note and Shen’s small-print note naming the twelve litter bearers are left out. Compared with the edition in the Kanseki Repository and with Project Gutenberg eBook 27292. Two readings follow the Kanseki text: 人火得水而滅 for the online 災, which makes no sense, and 鎔 for 镕, a simplified form.
edition.zh: 选卷十八、卷二十、卷二十一中的五则，据维基文库，所加卷名标题只为便于检索；这五则都不在本馆其他几种《梦溪笔谈》选本（S-002041、S-002042、S-006005）之中。《木经》一则删去异文小注“一作‘造’”、注音小注，以及沈括记述十二名抬辇人名称的小字原注。与京都大学汉籍资料库（Kanseki Repository）所收版本和古登堡计划电子书第 27292 号对校。两处依校本：“人火得水而灭”，维基文库作“灾”，文意不通；“鎔”字，维基文库误用了简体字形“镕”。

basis.en: Song dynasty prose; the author died in 1095.
basis.zh: 宋代散文，作者卒于 1095 年。

note.en: Five more of Shen Kuo’s notes: a builders’ manual of proportions and the master carpenter Yu Hao’s cure for a swaying pagoda; a meteorite that fell in a garden in 1064 and was kept in a temple box; a lightning strike that melted silver and steel and left lacquer and a scabbard untouched; and bamboo turned to stone far underground where no bamboo grows, which Shen explains by a change of climate. He records exactly, says when he cannot explain, and once, on the lightning, admits that the world is larger than our understanding.
note.zh: 沈括的另外五则笔记：一部讲建筑比例的匠人手册，以及大匠喻皓治好木塔晃动的办法；1064 年落在园子里、被寺院装匣收藏的一块陨石；一次雷击熔化了银器和钢刀，却没有烧焦漆器和刀鞘；还有在从不长竹子的地方、深埋地下的石化竹笋，沈括用古今气候的变化来解释。他记录得准确，解释不了时就直说，讲到雷火那一则，还承认世界比我们的理解更大。

excerpt.orig: 無乃曠古以前，地卑氣濕而宜竹耶？
excerpt.en: Could it be that in a remote antiquity the ground lay low and the air was damp and suited to bamboo?
excerpt.zh: 无乃旷古以前，地卑气湿而宜竹耶？

gloss.at: 謂之《木經》，或云喻皓所撰
gloss.en: The Timberwork Classic, a lost manual attributed to Yu Hao, the most famous master builder of the tenth century.
gloss.zh: 《木经》，已失传的建筑手册，相传为十世纪最有名的建筑工匠喻皓所作。
gloss.at_hans: 谓之《木经》，或云喻皓所撰

gloss.en: Every building has three parts: roof, body and base, each with its own rules of proportion.
gloss.zh: 房屋分为三部分：屋顶、屋身、台基，各有比例规定。

gloss.en: 極 is the ridge; its height is matched to the beam, and the rafters are graded accordingly.
gloss.zh: 极，屋脊；屋脊的高度与梁的长度相配，椽子的规格据此而定。榱，椽子。

gloss.en: Brackets, round rafters and square rafters.
gloss.zh: 斗拱和椽子。榱、桷都是椽子，圆的叫榱，方的叫桷。

gloss.en: In the palace the slope of a stair is judged by how the bearers of the imperial litter must hold its poles.
gloss.zh: 宫中以抬御辇的人持竿的姿势来衡量台阶的坡度。

gloss.en: The Qian family ruled the kingdom of Wuyue, east and west of the Zhe river, from 907 to 978.
gloss.zh: 钱氏建立的吴越国，据有浙东、浙西，907–978 年。

gloss.en: A temple in Hangzhou founded in 963; two stone sutra pillars from it still stand.
gloss.zh: 杭州的一座寺院，始建于 963 年，至今尚存两座石经幢。

gloss.en: The six faces, top, bottom and four sides, joined like a closed chest; 胠篋 is a box, from the Zhuangzi.
gloss.zh: 上下四方六个面相连，就像一只箱子。胠箧，箱子，语出《庄子》。

gloss.en: The first year of Zhiping: 1064.
gloss.zh: 宋英宗治平元年，即 1064 年。

gloss.en: The hour before noon, roughly nine to eleven in the morning.
gloss.zh: 禺中，将近中午的时候，约上午九时至十一时。

gloss.en: The Jinshan temple on an island in the Yangzi at Runzhou, present-day Zhenjiang.
gloss.zh: 润州（今江苏镇江）长江中金山上的寺院。

gloss.en: Wang Wujiu (1024–1069), a scholar and student of Wang Anshi; his account is lost.
gloss.zh: 王无咎（1024–1069），学者，王安石的门生；他的记述已经失传。

gloss.en: A palace eunuch, later a commander on the north-western frontier, where Shen Kuo also served.
gloss.zh: 宦官，后来在西北边境领兵，沈括也曾在那里任职。

gloss.en: Lacquerware with rims bound in silver.
gloss.zh: 用银镶口的漆器。扣，用金属镶边。

gloss.en: Melted to liquid inside the scabbard. 刀室 is the sheath. Lightning heats metal by electric current, which a dry sheath or lacquer does not carry.
gloss.zh: 在刀鞘里熔化成了汁水。刀室，刀鞘。闪电产生的电流使金属发热，而干燥的刀鞘和漆器并不导电。

gloss.at: 龍火得水而熾，人火得水而滅
gloss.en: A saying in Buddhist texts: lightning, the dragon’s fire, flares in rain; ordinary fire is put out by water.
gloss.zh: 佛书中的说法：雷电之火遇雨更旺，人间之火遇水则灭。
gloss.at_hans: 龙火得水而炽，人火得水而灭

gloss.en: A pass on the Yellow River in present-day northern Shaanxi, a dry loess country where Shen Kuo was military commissioner.
gloss.zh: 在今陕西北部黄河边，是干旱的黄土地区，沈括曾在这里任鄜延路经略使。

gloss.en: A palace envoy, a eunuch, happened to pass.
gloss.zh: 恰好有宦官经过。中人，宦官。

gloss.at: 無乃曠古以前，地卑氣濕而宜竹耶
gloss.en: One of the earliest arguments that fossils record a former climate. Modern scholars think the stalks were probably fossil horsetails.
gloss.zh: 这是最早用化石推论古代气候的论述之一。今人认为这些“竹笋”很可能是古代木贼类植物的化石。
gloss.at_hans: 无乃旷古以前，地卑气湿而宜竹耶

gloss.en: Petrified pine at Mount Jinhua in present-day Zhejiang.
gloss.zh: 婺州金华山（在今浙江）有松树化成的石头。
